selection_algorithm: Census of provider evaluation/test units; deterministic SHA-256 ordering for serialization only.

separation.CRAFT: Evaluation input and evaluation gold are separate provider archives; gold archive is skipped by default fetch.
separation.SCIREX: Labels are inline; inventory code retains only doc_id and official split, and data body is rights-gated. This is procedural blindness, not protected custody.
separation.OAEI: Input ontology paths and refalign.rdf gold paths are separable; inventory excludes refalign content.

authority_boundary: Public gold may support development transport and adverse coverage findings only. It may not be described as protected, fresh, independently commissioned, or completion of P3.PARTIAL_IDENTIFICATION.EXCESS_HARM.V1.
